message.content:
I need to understand the codebase structure for implementing a "reply to message" feature in a Matrix chat app. Please explore thoroughly:

1. Find the Matrix service file and understand how the SDK is used (look in src/modules/matrix-client/)
2. Find how messages are currently sent (look for send message functions)
3. Look at the MessageContentBottomSheet.tsx file to understand the current bottom sheet for message actions
4. Look at the timeline types (src/@types/timeline.d.ts)
5. Look at how the room screen works (src/screens/room/)
6. Find any existing reply-related code or assets (there are reply icons added)
7. Check what Matrix JS SDK version is being used (check package.json)
8. Look at how the text input / message composer works in the room screen

Please provide the full content of key files, especially:
- The matrix service file
- The MessageContentBottomSheet
- The timeline types
- The room screen main file
- Any message composer/input component
- package.json (just the matrix SDK dependency)
